entries.title: Psalms 39:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician, Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.>> I said, I will take heed to my ways, That I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, While the wicked is before me.

entries.title: Psalms 39:2
segments: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; And my sorrow was stirred.

entries.title: Psalms 39:3
segments: My heart was hot within me; While I was musing the fire burned: [Then] spake I with my tongue:

entries.title: Psalms 39:4
segments: Jehovah, make me to know mine end, And the measure of my days, what it is; Let me know how frail I am.

entries.title: Psalms 39:5
segments: Behold, thou hast made my days [as] handbreadths; And my life-time is as nothing before thee: Surely every man at his best estate is altogether vanity. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 39:6
segments: Surely every man walketh in a vain show; Surely they are disquieted in vain: He heapeth up [riches], and knoweth not who shall gather them.

entries.title: Psalms 39:7
segments: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope is in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 39:8
segments: Deliver me from all my transgressions: Make me not the reproach of the foolish.

entries.title: Psalms 39:9
segments: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; Because thou didst it.

entries.title: Psalms 39:10
segments: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.

entries.title: Psalms 39:11
segments: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: Surely every man is vanity. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 39:12
segments: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry; Hold not thy peace at my tears: For I am a stranger with thee, A sojourner, as all my fathers were.

entries.title: Psalms 39:13
segments: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, Before I go hence, and be no more.
